about: The literals the sheets still write (a px length other than 0 and 1, a raw colour, a duration, an opacity, a z-index, a mixed colour's strength, a length in em / rem / ch / vh / vw), by file, media, selector and property. The list may only shrink: scripts/check_ui_parameters.py refuses a literal that is not here; a category the gate newly counts is recorded once.
